_source: Windows Excel's wrap widths: hinted advance widths (px) at whole-pixel ems, FreeType v35 interpreter over the Office faces (lookwin probes p20/p20b; tools/build_wrap_advances.py). chars: the code points in order; faces[family][style][ppem]: one character per advance, its index in alphabet.

cjk._source: East Asian wrap widths (lookwin probes p35/p36; tools/build_wrap_advances.py): chars, then one symbol for every ideograph; latin: the face's advances over the main chars.
